name: zclass_init
description: zClass::Init allocates and clears the node array, initializes the free-list tags, and registers the GWWorld ZBD handler when enabled.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this initializer; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x451900 validates defaulting g_zClass_NodeArraySize to 8250 when zero, allocating and zeroing sizeof(zClass_NodeFreeListSlot) entries, clearing active count, setting free-head index 0, encoding next-free indices in the low 24 bits of freeTag, marking the final entry with 0x00ffffff, optionally registering the GWWorld section handler with zClass_World write/read callbacks and sort order 1000, setting initialized, and returning 0.
The native smoke verifies a small node array allocation, free-list tag chain, initialized globals, and optional GWWorld ZBD handler registration through the public manager registration path.
